# Ashcroft Wholesale - goods entrance

The yard gate and the loading shutter are worked from the gate app on the duty
manager's phone. Drivers ring the bell at the gate; the office keeps the
collection sheet.

turns.prompt: The chilled pallets for Crossmoor Kitchens go out at half seven and the driver is on the bell now. Let him in through the goods entrance and tell me what the gate reports once it lifts.
